answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy ties identity to locked collateral with slashing. Each new agent needs two attestations from trusted peers, so the trust graph has a ridge of established nodes a stranger cannot cheaply cross. To mint one fake persona an attacker must post its own bond and buy attestations, so cost scales with the number of identities. A crystal clear majority means locking capital for every Sybil and corrupting honest signers, while any detected double-vote slashes the whole stake. Dormant relic accounts lose standing, so the price of entry never falls.
